excavation_context.stage: Cleaving Brittle Sediments from a Large Carnosaur Block

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_4, wearing his signature black aviator glasses, carefully handles a fine parting tool to flake away layers of a soft, fine-grained greenish-grey claystone matrix out on an open semi-arid plain. The parting of the stone cleanly uncovers the large, distinctive bony crest and skull element of an Allosaurus. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
